method: Committed inventories only. This container refuses egress to court and agency hosts, so no URL was fetched, no form number was guessed, and no unofficial mirror was accepted in place of an available official original. Every digest quoted for a held document was recomputed from the mounted Master Library bytes in this lane.
releaseNote: Empty, and it stays empty. Prospective release is never actual release: not one of the 28 families has every remaining source bound, and settling an identity binds no bytes.
grantsNothing: A bound source is a bound source. It builds nothing, proves nothing and approves nothing.

rows.urlKind: none — there is no document to address
rows.intendedPacketRole: none
rows.finding: The label is honest. RCW 13.50.260(1)-(2) relief is court-initiated: the court sets the administrative sealing hearing at disposition and enters the sealing order on its own findings, so the participant files nothing and there is no participant-facing document for this family to name. The three JU pattern forms (JU 10.0300 Motion and Declaration to Seal Records of Juvenile Offender, JU 10.0315 Notice of Respondent's Motion to Seal, JU 10.0320 Order Re: Sealing Records of Juvenile Offender) are real, are published by Washington Courts and are the MOTION path under RCW 13.50.260(3) — a different route, which the Captain has already decided is a separate family if it is wanted at all.

rows.issuingAuthority: Delaware State Police, State Bureau of Identification (SBI)
rows.urlKind: no binary address established; the publisher's programme page is https://dsp.delaware.gov/expungements/ and it is a landing page
rows.intendedPacketRole: the application a participant submits to SBI for mandatory expungement under 11 Del. C. § 4373
rows.finding: The publisher is settled beyond doubt: the Delaware State Police State Bureau of Identification, under 11 Del. C. § 4373, and its programme page is https://dsp.delaware.gov/expungements/ (hostAllowed true). What is NOT settled, and what this lane concludes is probably not settleable by acquisition, is a published blank application: the publisher's own instruction documents describe the mandatory path as an SBI-issued letter with individualised instructions mailed to the applicant with their certified criminal history, and neither Delaware instruction packet, neither Delaware court guide, nor any committed record in this repository names a form number, a title or a revision for it. An acquisition dispatched at the programme page will return a page, not a form. That outcome is already visible in this manifest for other landing-page entries and would waste a fetch and read as a gap.
rows.nextOperationOwner: The question is not 'which URL' and it is not a question for a clerk. It is: does Delaware publish a mandatory-expungement application at all, or is the § 4373 mandatory path an SBI-initiated determination the participant triggers by requesting a certified criminal history? If the latter, de_mandatory_expungement-set is modelled official_pdf_fill on a document that does not exist, and the honest treatment is guidance — request the certified history through IdentoGo service code 27S23V, wait for the SBI eligibility letter, follow the instructions it carries — exactly as the Washington juvenile family resolved. A single human read of https://dsp.delaware.gov/expungements/ settles it; this container cannot make that read.

rows.finding: Nothing was outstanding; the address is in the manifest as mt-mmrta-form-b-petition-sentence-completed with the exact obligationKey, already fetched. The face read confirms Form A and Form B are two documents distinguished by posture — 'currently serving your sentence' against 'where Sentence has been served' — and confirms the relief they request differs too: Form A offers expungement OR RESENTENCING, Form B offers expungement OR REDESIGNATION. A packet lane must not substitute one for the other.

rows.issuingAuthority: Montana Office of the Court Administrator (Montana Judicial Branch)
rows.officialTitle: MT-OCA-MMRTA is a constructed set identifier, not a printed title. It covers two companion instruments: 'Proposed Order Granting Expungement / Resentencing / Redesignation of a Marijuana-Related Conviction (MMRTA)' and 'Certificate of Service — MMRTA Petition'.
rows.formNumber: none. Neither document prints a form number anywhere on its face — verified by reading both in this lane.
rows.revision: none printed. Document metadata dates them 2022-02 (proposed order) and 2022-03 (certificate of service).
rows.intendedPacketRole: proposed_order (order 3) and certificate_of_service (order 2) — both marked requirement 'required' on this route
rows.finding: The label does not name one document and it never did. The composed-route dependency files say so in their own words: 'Master Library Edition 1.1 gives the OCA MMRTA Proposed Order and the OCA MMRTA Certificate of Service the same document ID, MT-OCA-MMRTA, distinguished only by document role, ORDER against SERVICE. They are two different binaries with two different SHA-256 values, so a component naming MT-OCA-MMRTA matches two retained assets carrying conflicting hashes and the authority gate records an authority hash conflict.' This is NOT a pick-one ambiguity: both instruments are requirement 'required' on this route and the route files both. The certificate of service is required by § 16-12-113(5)(b) and is marked required on the face of both Form A and Form B; the proposed order is submitted with the petition. Two exact binary addresses are established for the first time and carried in manifestEntriesAdded.
rows.nextOperationOwner: Acquisition, for the two new addresses. Then the census owner, to split MT-OCA-MMRTA into two per-instrument identities — the registry already records that split as the mechanical cure and this lane does not own the census vocabulary. Until the split, the family keeps sourceState FAMILY_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS mechanically (model check S11) even though nothing about the documents is ambiguous any more.

rows.nextOperationOwner: Source promotion, not acquisition — re-fetching a document that returned HTTP 200 four days ago is the exact waste the 2026-08-31 batch demonstrated. What PROMO must check on promotion, because this lane could not: that the acquired PDF's own face prints 'Order of Nondisclosure' and §411.0736, and not §411.0731 or the combined §411.0725/411.073/411.0735 order. The publisher issues one combined order for three sections, so a section-specific order is exactly where a mis-bind would hide.

rows.issuingAuthority: Virginia General Assembly (law.lis.virginia.gov) for the statute; the Supreme Court of Virginia's Office of the Executive Secretary publishes the CC-series district and circuit court forms
rows.intendedPacketRole: the participant petition for expungement following an absolute pardon under Va. Code § 19.2-392.2
rows.statewideOrLocal: statewide statute; the second recorded URL is one circuit court's own page and is local
rows.finding: The statute address is official and settled. The document is not. The corpus holds four current Virginia petitions, all REV-2026-07 — CC-1473 Petition for Expungement, CC-1201 and CC-1203 Petitions for Sealing, with addenda CC-1201-A, CC-1203-A and CC-1203-B — and no committed record binds any of them to the absolute-pardon route. Choosing between an expungement petition and a sealing petition for a pardon-based route is a legal determination, not a discovery one. The other recorded URL, norfolkcircuitcourt.us, is one circuit court's page: it is official for Norfolk and cannot settle a statewide identity.
rows.nextOperationOwner: source reconciliation — bind one of the held CC-series petitions to the absolute-pardon route, or record that the route needs a legal determination first
